full: Use case: product-mockup. Expand the attached prong-free diamond bezel macro into a NEW full luxury watch photograph with the ENTIRE closed silver three-link bracelet visible, three-quarter front angle, isolated pale grey background. The macro is the ONLY setting reference. Preserve its smooth broad polished metal plate between the diamonds: separated round brilliant stones sit in clean circular apertures flush to the plate, crowns exposed, support entirely underneath. Leave a clearly visible broad flat polished metal bridge between adjacent stones. NO metal beads, NO studs, NO claws, NO prongs, NO posts anywhere around any diamond. Use 24 evenly spaced round diamonds around full bezel instead of tightly packed pave. Black sunray dial with silver baton indices and three hands, brushed steel case, polished edge, complete curved closed bracelet with clasp, crown. Studio photorealism with fine brushing, planar facets and controlled dynamic striplight reflections, cool white sparkle with subtle warm edge light. Entire object fits with margin, no cropping, no text, logos or watermark. Priority is the absolutely smooth prong-free bezel from reference, not a conventional diamond watch.
views: Use case: product-mockup. Create a matching reference photograph of the exact watch in the attached image. Preserve the silver three-link closed bracelet, proportions, circular black sunray dial, baton markers, crown and polished broad smooth diamond bezel. All diamond seats must remain clean circular apertures with exposed crowns and smooth flat metal between stones. NO prongs, beads, claws, studs or posts. Photoreal high detail brushed metal microtexture, controlled dynamic studio stripbox lighting, crisp facets, neutral grey background. Whole watch including entire bracelet uncropped with margins. No text, logo, labels or watermark. View:
side: EXACT RIGHT SIDE PROFILE, camera rotated 90 degrees away from dial front, looking squarely at winding crown. Dial face barely visible as thin ellipse, NOT front three-quarter. Complete closed bracelet forms an oval loop visibly behind thin case. Maintain identical watch and prong-free smooth bezel. High-texture luxury product photography.
front: Front: straight-on face with crown on right, full bracelet loop behind, centered symmetric product photograph.
back: Back: rear three-quarter angle showing circular brushed caseback, screws, clasp and entire closed bracelet loop; leave caseback visible beside the nearer bracelet.
rejected: First edit retained conventional metal beads; rejected.
Initial side output was too frontal; replaced with stronger side-profile prompt.
